paper.title: From disorder to order in marching locusts

headline: Buhl et al. 2006 marching locusts (Czirok 1D SPP, genuine-agent): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; density crossover mean|<v>| 0.24@rho=0.10 -> 0.88@rho=1.00; near-critical (rho=0.20) switches 4/6 seeds vs high-density (rho=1.50) median 0 flips

verdicts.gate: P1 density crossover: mean |<v>| < 0.3 at lowest density AND > 0.7 at highest density
P2 intermittent switching: near-critical density reverses (rate>0, >=1 seed) while the high-density median run never reverses (rate~=0)
P3 monotone ordering: mean |<v>| non-decreasing in density (tol 0.05)

extra.dynamics: Czirok 1D self-propelled-particle update: per-agent local neighbour average over the real ring geometry, tanh(beta*u) alignment response + uniform heading noise, sign update, fixed-speed move with periodic wrap; synchronous tick; density = N/Lr swept via ring length at fixed N
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published self-propelled-particle model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the Buhl-et-al. density-driven order/disorder transition with near-critical intermittent direction reversals (the 1D ring signature) and would catch an artifact

citations: Buhl, J., Sumpter, D.J.T., Couzin, I.D., Hale, J.J., Despland, E., Miller, E.R. & Simpson, S.J. (2006). From disorder to order in marching locusts. Science 312(5778):1402-1406. doi:10.1126/science.1125142.

Czirok, A., Barabasi, A.-L. & Vicsek, T. (1999). Collective motion of self-propelled particles: kinetic phase transition in one dimension. Physical Review Letters 82:209-212. doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.82.209.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the Buhl-et-al. density-driven order/disorder transition (order-parameter crossover, near-critical intermittent switching, monotone ordering)
